metadata.Name: GoEmotions
metadata.Description: GoEmotions is a large dataset of Reddit comments labeled for 27 emotions or Neutral, designed for fine-grained emotion classification.
metadata.Paper Title: GoEmotions: A Dataset of Fine-Grained Emotions
metadata.Abstract: Our dataset is composed of 58K Reddit comments, labeled for one or more of 27 emotion(s) or Neutral. We identify harmful comments using pre-defined lists containing offensive/adult, vulgar, identity, and religion terms. We assign three raters to each example, and for those examples where no raters agree on at least one emotion label, we assign two additional raters. We present a strong baseline emotion prediction model for GoEmotions, and conduct transfer learning experiments on existing emotion benchmarks to show that our data generalizes well to different domains and taxonomies.
